scope: Explicit linked meeting-document file/index preparation only; no tenant import, Agenda entity mutation or live acceptance inferred.

rules: Tagged Fields; Field Delimiters None; Separator New Line.
Vendor figure shows BEGIN: alone, then DocTypeName:value, ordinary keyword tags/value and FullPath:path. Tags are configured mappings, not universal property names.
contract_rules.figure_proof: Exact vendor-linked GIF retained; it is a vendor example, not municipal data or an executed import.

rules: Exclusive Begin marks a document boundary and is case-sensitive.
Document Type name/number must match destination configuration. File Type is a configured numeric file-format identity.
File Type must precede file path; Full Path includes drive/UNC. No type number is inferred.
Tags at most20 characters. Each value has its mapped tag; Begin separates documents.
Exact case-sensitive tags include any separator character. Repeated keyword values may use the same tag.
Normal DIP without FTP: File Name alone locates files in the index directory.
File Type precedes FullPath or FileName; omitted type uses Document Type default. Destination configuration is required per Document Type.
File Name/full path/composite path may be260 characters; exporter uses shorter120-character basenames. Validate total extraction path before processing.
Test Only produces a verification report without document creation/copy/source deletion.
Export preparation never runs this vendor operation or a batch commit.

verification: Synthetic emitted index checked against independently specified vendor layout/ordering and exact file hashes; not remote import or Agenda API acceptance.
